title: 10 Best Galium Verum Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Galium verum are teas, decoctions, tinctures, mucillages, and oils, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from dried leaves and flowers are commonly used to soothe digestive issues and promote relaxation. Decoctions, involving longer boiling times, are preferred for extracting more potent compounds from the roots. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, often used for its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s gelatinous tissues, are valued for their soothing effects on the respiratory and digestive tracts. Oils infused with Galium verum are used topically to alleviate skin irritations and support healing.
